name: Jord Knotter
biography: Jord Knotter (born November 19, 1989) is a Dutch actor and voice performer. A graduate of the Maastricht Academy of Dramatic Arts, he achieved widespread public recognition starring as Job Zonneveld in the popular soap opera Goede Tijden, Slechte Tijden (2016–2017). His television credits encompass appearances in Dutch series such as Spangas, VRijland, Moordvrouw, Flikken Maastricht, and Dertigers. In feature films, he has appeared in titles including SneekWeek (2016), Prey (2016), and Bon Bini Academy (2020).
